plan.iterationTitle: 迁移首批视图注册至 ViewRouter，App.tsx 条件分支数减半
steps: Step 1: Define ViewConfig type in routing/index.ts — schema for declarative view registration (id, title, i18n, icon, a11y-role)
Step 2: Create useViewRegistry hook in routing/useViewRegistry.ts — manages view registry state and registration
Step 3: Update ViewRouter to support registry-based rendering — accepts registry map, uses registry[view] if exists, falls back to switch for existing views
Step 4: Add ViewRegistryContext in NavigationContext.tsx — provides registry access to all components
Step 5: Refactor App.tsx to use ViewRegistry — register views via registry instead of passing 20+ callback props; reduce viewHandlers complexity
Step 6: Update ViewNavigator to support registry-based navigation — navigate() reads from registry for metadata
Step 7: Write ViewRouter registry tests (ViewRouter.registry.test.tsx) — verify registry registration, rendering, fallback behavior
Step 8: Update App routing tests (App.routing.test.tsx with registry pattern)
Step 9: Run full test suite (2367 tests expected) — verify zero regression
Step 10: Build + Lint verification — 3.5s build, 0 lint errors
plan.testStrategy: ViewRouter registry registration (20 tests) + App.tsx routing integration (30 tests) + NavigationContext registry context (10 tests) = 60 new tests. Full suite expected: 2367 tests, zero regression.
